mapper.select: SELECT t1.* FROM biz_prompt_comment t1 LEFT JOIN biz_prompt_template t3 ON t1.prompt_id = t3.id WHERE t1.deleted = 0 AND t3.template_type = #{platform} AND t1.id NOT IN ( SELECT comment_id FROM biz_prompt_comment_complete WHERE media_account_id = #{mediaAccountId} AND deleted = 0 ) LIMIT 100

SELECT t1.* FROM biz_prompt_comment t1 LEFT JOIN biz_prompt_comment_complete t2_outer ON t1.id = t2_outer.comment_id AND t2_outer.media_account_id = #{mediaAccountId} AND t2_outer.deleted = 0 WHERE t1.deleted = 0 AND t2_outer.id IS NULL AND t1.operate_group_id = ( SELECT tmp.operate_group_id FROM biz_prompt_comment tmp LEFT JOIN biz_prompt_comment_complete t2 ON tmp.id = t2.comment_id AND t2.media_account_id = #{mediaAccountId} AND t2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_prompt_template t3 ON tmp.prompt_id = t3.id WHERE tmp.deleted = 0 AND t2.id IS NULL AND t3.template_type = #{platform} LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY t1.id ASC
